answer: Because the oasis stake is held until the sable settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the copper audit lists each exposure. A farm running 165 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. An attester must stake 7% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
